description: Full-text search across The Guardian's archive (1999–present) with optional section, tag, contributor, and date filters. Returns articles with full body text (HTML stripped, truncated at 2,000 words). Use guardian_browse_content with mode=list_sections or mode=list_tags to discover valid filter IDs before searching. Powered by The Guardian (open-platform.theguardian.com).

contributor.description: Restrict to articles by this contributor tag ID (e.g. "profile/georgemonbiot"). Contributor IDs follow the pattern "profile/<slug>". Use guardian_browse_content with mode=list_tags and tag_type=contributor to discover contributor IDs.

from_date.description: Return only articles published on or after this real calendar date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2024-01-15"). Blank is omitted.

order_by.description: Sort order. "relevance" ranks by match strength (default when a query is provided). "newest" and "oldest" sort by publication date.

page.description: Page number (1-indexed). Each page returns up to page_size results.

page_size.description: Number of results per page (1–50). Keep low (≤10) when requesting full body text to manage context size. Large bodies can be 10–30KB each.

query.description: Full-text search query. Supports AND, OR, NOT operators and exact phrases in double quotes. Example: "climate change" AND (policy OR legislation)

section.description: Restrict results to a section ID (e.g. "world", "politics", "science", "environment", "technology", "culture", "sport", "lifeandstyle"). Use guardian_browse_content with mode=list_sections to discover valid section IDs.

tag.description: Restrict to content carrying this tag ID (e.g. "environment/climate-crisis", "technology/artificial-intelligence", "world/ukraine"). Supports comma (AND), pipe | (OR), hyphen - (NOT), and parentheses. OR example: environment/climate-crisis|environment/flooding. When combining with contributor, group compound expressions: (environment/climate-crisis|environment/flooding). The service comma-joins tag and contributor unchanged. Use guardian_browse_content with mode=list_tags to discover valid tag IDs.

to_date.description: Return only articles published on or before this real calendar date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. "2024-03-31"). Blank is omitted.

name: guardian_search_articles

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unauthorized`: The Guardian API returned 401 — the API key is missing or invalid. `no_results`: The query returned zero results. `invalid_date`: from_date or to_date is not a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format. `request_rejected`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 400. `access_denied`: The Guardian API denied access. `validation_failed`: The Guardian API rejected a parameter value. `invalid_request`: The Guardian API cannot serve this request. `request_conflict`: The Guardian API reported a request conflict. `request_not_found`: The Guardian API could not find the requested endpoint. `api_timeout`: The Guardian request timed out or the API returned a timeout status. `rate_limited`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 429. `api_unsupported`: The Guardian API returned HTTP 501. `api_error`: The Guardian API returned a retryable server failure (excluding HTTP 501), an HTML error page, or a network failure. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when the search returned zero results — echoes the query and suggests how to broaden.

page_size.description: Number of results in this response.

body.description: Full article body text (HTML stripped). Truncated at 2,000 words with a note if longer. Use guardian_get_article with this id as article_id for the complete text.

contributors.description: Authors and contributors attached to this article.

items.description: A contributor attached to this article.

id.description: Contributor tag ID (use as contributor filter in guardian_search_articles).
Guardian article ID (path slug, e.g. "world/2024/mar/01/title"). Pass to guardian_get_article to fetch this article directly.

thumbnail.description: URL of the article thumbnail image.

truncated.description: True when the body was truncated at 2,000 words.

web_url.description: URL of the article on theguardian.com.

word_count.description: Article word count (absent on galleries, interactives, and some live content).

total.description: Total matching articles across all pages.

totalCount.description: Total matching articles across all pages — discloses how many results exist beyond this capped page.

title: Search Guardian Articles
